description: Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles is an open data portal listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles. The portal lists 1,273 datasets (read in full on 2026-09-30) published by Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles for Wallonia and Brussels; the ones about transport, energy, water, digital networks, waste and buildings are catalogued as records of their own, the others (population, health, culture, budgets and similar) are outside the scope of this catalogue. 217 datasets are covered by earlier records (92 of them Infrabel datasets that sit under records of Infrabel's own portal), and 167 further datasets became 97 new records on 2026-09-30, one per dataset or one per group of related datasets. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. 1,273 datasets are listed in the live catalogue; 384 of them are about infrastructure and are covered by records (the audit file odwb-live-audit.csv names the outcome of every dataset). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure data of this area. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
